task.title: Catalog paging UI fixes
task.description:
Catalog should render page #s that serve as paging links.
Show up to 6 page numbers, always showing a page [1] and the last page, and having the main group of links counting up from the current page, until a user reaches the end of the pages in which case it counts down.
"Next page" and "Previous" page buttons should always wrap the page number links, and all of these should be left-justified. This updates the currently right-aligned "Next page" button and replaces the "Back to start" button.
Some examples:
 - If there are 28 pages of results to show and the user is on page 9, the rendered navigation would be:
`[Prev] [1] ... 9 [10] [11] [12] ... [28] [Next]` (note that the 9 is rendered but not a link since it is the current page)

 - If there are 28 pages and the user is on page 1:
`Prev 1 [2] [3] [4] [5] ... [28] [Next]` (no Prev button because we're on the first page)

 - If there are 10 pages and the user is on page 9:
`[Prev] [1] ... [6] [7] [8] 9 [10] [Next]` (Still show the Next button even though it's navigation overlaps with the [10] link)
